blocks.text: 2 Samuel 10 contains 19 verses. It opens with: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead. It concludes with: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.
